detail.longDescription: Introducing Meala — an open source UAV flight log database & cross-stack telemetry normalizer. Ingest ArduPilot (.bin/.tlog), PX4 (.ulg), and CSV logs into SQLite/PostgreSQL + Apache Parquet for fast SQL filtering, FFT vibration analysis, and multi-flight overlays. Docs: https:// meala.dev GitHub: https:// github.com/mealadev # UAV # Drones # ArduPilot # PX4 # MAVLink # OpenSource # Python
